name: workflow-loop
description: A streamlined project workflow: explore, approve, write the plan, implement, and review with optional Claude collaboration.

interface.shortDescription: Explore, approve, plan, and deliver in one conversation
interface.longDescription: Six skills share a lightweight workflow harness. Brainstorm presents a proposal for approval, the plan writer saves it, and a readiness checkpoint leads to implementation and independent review. Orchestrate chooses the applicable stage. Includes three companion agents and optional Claudex consultation for difficult physics or logic.
defaultPrompt: Use orchestrate to carry this work through implementation and review.
Use brainstorm to explore an idea and present a plan for my approval.
Use backlog to choose the next project item.
